pathways.name: Emerging Localized Loss
pathways.blurb: Decades of shared regional growth, turning to local loss by 2010–20, often at the edge of growing regions.

pathways.name: Isolated Loss
pathways.blurb: Losing population while neighbouring counties grow: islands of loss inside growing regions.

pathways.name: Persistent Loss
pathways.blurb: Loss shared with neighbours in most decades since 1950; concentrated in the Great Plains and central Appalachia.

pathways.name: Punctuated Regionalized Loss
pathways.blurb: Alternating growth and loss, with loss shared across the region since 2010.

pathways.name: Constant Growth
pathways.blurb: County and neighbours growing in nearly every decade.

pathways.name: Localized Recovery and Regional Growth
pathways.blurb: Growing regions where the county lost population for a time, then recovered after 1990.

pathways.name: Punctuated Growth
pathways.blurb: Cycles of growth and loss, ending in recent growth.

pathways.name: Emerging Growth
pathways.blurb: Long-run loss turning to growth in the latest decades.

citation.title: Characterizing the Landscape of Loss: A Spatiotemporal Contextual Approach to Measuring U.S. County-Level Depopulation
citation.journal: Annals of the American Association of Geographers
citation.text: Park, G., Seymour, E., and Franklin, R. (2026). Characterizing the Landscape of Loss: A Spatiotemporal Contextual Approach to Measuring U.S. County-Level Depopulation. Annals of the American Association of Geographers. doi:10.1080/24694452.2026.2691208

notes.geography: 3,108 conterminous U.S. counties in 2020 boundaries. Shannon County, SD (46113) is recoded to Oglala Lakota County (46102), and Bedford city, VA (51515) is counted in Bedford County (51019).
notes.base2010: The 2010 count is the Schroeder (2016) workbook value used by the paper's sequences. It differs slightly from the GeoPackage's 2010 field in 716 counties; the workbook value is used everywhere.
notes.changeClasses: Decadal change uses five classes with exact breaks: 20% or more; 10% to under 20%; 0% to under 10%; under 0% to above −10%; −10% or less. These colours differ from the published Figure 1, whose breaks at ±9.9% and 19.9% misplace some counties.
notes.neighbours: Neighbours are queen-contiguous counties. Neighbour change is population-weighted: the sum of neighbours' change over the sum of their starting populations. Dukes and Nantucket, MA, and San Juan, WA, have no neighbours and count as neighbours-growth.
notes.rucc: RUCC 2023 codes Connecticut by planning region, not county; the 2013 code is used for metro status.
